description: Lotame Lightning Tag on tags.crwdcntrl.net/lt/c/{clientId}/lt.min.js. The client ID rides in the path as an integer. bcp.crwdcntrl.net collect is not contracted.

params.name: client_id
params.description: It is the Lotame client ID. Lotame documents the loader as tags.crwdcntrl.net/lt/c/{lotameClientId}/lt.min.js and Number(lotameClientId).
params.fix_hint: Replace {lotameClientId} with the numeric client ID from Lotame, such as /lt/c/123456/lt.min.js.
